name: itsomidho
description: Claude Code plugins by Omid Hosseini

plugins.name: clawd-statusbar
plugins.description: A framed status bar with git, pipeline and usage figures, and Clawd frying an egg while Claude works

plugins.name: clawd-tasks
plugins.description: A live task board: Claude's plan, and under each task the steps it took, how long it ran, the files it changed and the agents it started

plugins.name: clawd-guard
plugins.description: A safety net: stops risky shell commands, writes to secret files and leaked keys before they run, with a band that counts what it caught

plugins.name: clawd-notify
plugins.description: Tells you when Claude is done or needs you: a desktop notification, a chime, and optionally a push to your phone

plugins.name: clawd-git
plugins.description: A live git panel beside the conversation: files, changes, diffs and the commit graph; marks what Claude changed, stages, commits and asks Claude to review

plugins.name: clawd-logs
plugins.description: Watches your project's error logs (WordPress debug.log, nginx, any log file): new errors above the prompt, grouped, with a Fix button, and Claude hears about the ones its own work caused
